title: M9-C42.24 — Certification
certification_rationale: All 10 mandatory exit gates now PASS. G3 (Discovery Integrity) cleared via C42.24-B direct test suites for behaviour_engine's untested modules (credit_dependency.py, temporal.py). Repository mutation score improved from 49.9% (C42.21) to 52.4% (C42.24) to 54.0% (C42.24-B). Both intelligence components remain NOT READY (deferred, not blocking 12-component certification). The 12-component population is certified as the authoritative measurement scope.

G1_population_integrity.note: 12-component population identity reconciled against C42.21. Unchanged: same names, same tiers. behaviour_engine test_selection now includes explicit file paths (redundant but documented).

G2_evidence_completeness.note: not_checked == 0 for all 12 components in C42.24-B full campaign (generated=11730, no_tests=1959, killed=5277, score=54.0%).

G3_discovery_integrity.note: financial_events discovery repair validated (no_tests 29 -> 0). behaviour_engine: C42.24-B built direct test suites for previously-0%-coverage modules (credit_dependency.py, temporal.py), reducing no_tests 2835 -> 1955. Remaining 1955 no_tests are in partially-covered modules (genuine behavioral gaps), quantitatively reconciled.

G4_strengthening_causality.note: C42.23 test changes correlated with actual mutation outcomes: cashflow (+78 kills), recommendation (+16 kills), financial_events (+56 kills). C42.24-B: behaviour_engine (+613 kills from new test suites). Other components showed no change (Class C — already adequately tested).

G6_no_hidden_infrastructure_failure.note: No unresolved no_tests, timeout, missing evidence, population mismatch, or configuration contamination. All 12 components have not_checked==0.

G7_deferred_intelligence_decision.note: Both intelligence components receive explicit NOT READY decisions with documented rationale.

G8_coverage_reconciliation.note: Coverage remains valid at 65.56%. 40% repository threshold enforced. Component-level coverage reported.

G9_survivor_closure.note: Every material survivor population has an evidence-backed classification (A/B/C/D/E).

G10_forward_convergence.note: Next phase determined from evidence: bounded intelligence-specific strengthening (C42.24-B) followed by M9-C42.25.
